reviews.text: Very reasonably priced and speedy service! My key fob (for a hybrid that needs the fob to start) was kind of broken, and then I locked it in the car... KeyTech came out the same day and clearly knew what he was doing—I thought I needed a new key fob, which I did get, but he also fixed my original one, so now I won't get stuck again! It was much less of a mental and financial pain than trying to figure out how to work with and/or wait for the dealership. Definitely recommend!
reviews.author: Wendy Comet

reviews.text:
Accidentally found this guy. I needed a second fob and had been searching for 2 years. Yesterday a pooka or fairy took off with my keys. They're gone. I have a key, that sets my alarm off, and need a fob to make it stop.
My friend who has the same type vehicle needed a chipped key and a fob that needed programmed.
30 minutes later he was done and we were gone, not missing arms or legs, and a bank account that was cheering, instead of sobbing. He's friendly, fast, responsive and mobile.
Long story short....
KeyTech works smarter so you don't stress harder.
reviews.author: Angelica Brucker

reviews.text: These fellas were super accommodating, they didn’t know my key would be a jaguar key type before arriving but made it work despite the difficulty and peculiar nature of this type of key. Their price was great and work has been thorough. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Andrew Keeler

reviews.text: Very nice, helpful, and knowledgeable. My key had snapped and I was locked out of my car, Kareem helped me get into my car and made me new keys with chips at a very reasonable price. If you have any lock related issues I highly recommend Keytech Gresham!
reviews.author: Braden Paukert

reviews.text: Accidentally locked the keys in the car. This company had all 5 star reviews and was supposed to be local to Gresham but the dispatcher when we called the number had no idea where Powell Butte was. They sent someone out quickly but were unwilling to give any sort of price quote or range until they'd unlocked the car, and the price was on the highest end of what we'd seen online (not from this business).
reviews.author: Amber Broughton
